title: Script Of J | esp, noclip and more
features:
🔥 Script Of J — Features

👁️ Player Highlights — Easily see other players with customizable ESP highlights. 

🎨 Custom Colors — Change fill and outline colours and transparency.

🧱 Wall Visibility — Highlights can remain visible through walls.

🚶 Noclip — Walk through walls and other collidable objects.

🔄 Auto Respawn — Noclip and self-highlighting can automatically resume after respawning.

💬 Discord — Quickly copy the Script Of J Discord invite if there's any issues with the script.

changelog.message: Join the discord server if there are any bugs
